title: [DEV] Cropped boxy top from an oversized button-down
body: Cuts the body of an oversized shirt to a boxy cropped length and re-hems it. Placeholder DEV content, not reviewed.
tools: fabric chalk, scissors, sewing machine, iron
steps: Try the shirt on and mark the new hem with chalk|Lay it flat and cut 4 cm below the chalk line, keeping the hem even|Fold the raw edge 1 cm twice and press|Topstitch the hem close to the fold

title: [DEV] Convert a striped button-down into a wrap-style top
body: Turns a button-down into a wrap top by removing the buttons and adding side ties. Placeholder DEV content, not reviewed.
tools: seam ripper, scissors, sewing machine, matching thread
steps: Unpick the front buttons and button band with a seam ripper|Cut two 60 cm ties from the removed fabric|Stitch a tie to each front edge at waist height|Press the edges and finish them with a narrow hem
